summary: Evolus, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a License, Supply and Distribution Agreement with IBSA for exclusive U.S. rights to Profhilo, a hyaluronic acid product for aesthetic skin-quality applications. No upfront or milestone payments are required; Evolus funds all U.S. development and regulatory work leading to FDA approval, then purchases product under a transfer-price model with minimum purchase commitments starting in year four post-launch. The initial term is 15 years from FDA approval with renewal options. This is a routine licensing agreement, not a special situation—no acquisition, divestiture, tender, or corporate control change is involved.
